correctness.rationale: On each rooted tree, a successful directed path must choose the unique edge toward the caster. Conditional on a parent action date t, different child subtrees separate; induction gives F_v(t)=a_v(t)+sum_c max_{s: s-h_c(s)≤t≤s} F_c(s), with -infinity signaling infeasibility. The caster may be cited at any time >=σ because its casting commitment persists; independently maximize immediate child F_c(s) over s≥σ. Interval-stabbing maxima by left-endpoint buckets and expiring max heap yield O(M+nL log(L+1)) time and O(nL+M) space, including backpointers. At four vertices a,b→v→r with zero horizons, a can only meet v at time1, b only at time2; v’s time3 outgoing action points backward, so individually each has a route but jointly no common action. Direct independent brute-force confirms no joint action; at <=3 voters any rooted tree is a star/path where individual feasible paths assemble. Finite tests are corroboration only.
